notes:
Lead context and summary:
- SMB support platform powering chat + knowledge base search for 1st-line agents. 6-figure ARR target within 12 months.
- Primary ask: reduce latency for EU customers and get predictable perf for live chat.
- Current setup: using hosted API from client libraries, default region routing (no pinning). Mostly public cloud.
- Observed problem: occasional p95 spikes > 2.5s for short chat turns (50-120 tokens). User quote: "Sometimes the chat freezes for a few seconds — kills conversion."
- Cost sensitivity: wants suggestions to lower token usage without harming accuracy.
- SE notes (Rafael): likely causes = region routing mismatch, client timeout too long/too short in some paths, lack of streaming, prompt verbosity.
- Immediate triage steps performed: looked at sample request IDs (INF-3217), advised enabling streaming for chat turns, suggested lowering default completion max_tokens for ephemeral assistant replies. Customer saw ~10-15% p50 improvement on short prompts after streaming enabled.
- Recommendations prepared for POC: 1) Region pinning: deploy/route eu traffic to eu-west1 endpoints to reduce cross-region hops; 2) Timeout policy: set socket timeout to 20s, api-level request timeout to 15s for UI flows — allow streaming fallback; 3) Prompt tuning: enforce system message + short user prompts, use retrieval-augmented snippets limited to 600 tokens; 4) Batching & cache: enable prefix KV cache for repeated KB calls; 5) Monitor: p50/p95, token counts, and cost per 1k responses on dashboard.
- Security/ops: needs SSO (SAML) + audit logs but not strict residency. No on-prem requirement today.
- POC success criteria (customer): p95 < 1.2s for <150-token replies for EU region, <= 10% token cost increase compared to baseline, no increase in error rates.
- Quote from customer during call: "If we can make EU feel as snappy as US, we'll move to paid plan."
- Next actions (short): Rafael to send POC test harness + templated prompt guidelines; Maya to schedule kickoff 2026-03-12; SE to open INF-3224 to track POC telemetry collection.
- Internal follow-ups: check SDK default timeout docs, consider adding a small public-cloud region pinning how-to in docs for self-serve users.
